verdict.rationale: SigNoz has a programmatic API (service accounts are documented for API access), so asking for a downloadable API spec is fair. However, the evidence documents no OpenAPI or equivalent spec, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. Dashboard JSON export, llms.txt and the MCP server are different capabilities and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
